DESCRIPTION_KR: Dolby Atmos is an object-based surround sound format that supports height channels, which means sound can come from above your head. It results in an even more immersive listening experience since, depending on your home theater setup, you can hear sounds coming from all directions. Many 4k Blu-rays and even some streaming services like Netflix support Dolby Atmos—but not all soundbars do. The ones that do tend to be more expensive than most, but if you're after a more natural listening experience, they're worth considering. Soundbars usually use up-firing speakers to simulate an illusion of height by bouncing the sound off the ceiling and back to the listener. It won't be as accurate or immersive as down-firing speakers with a more traditional home theater setup.

DESCRIPTION_KR: This product is an independent photoelectric smoke fire detection alarm (hereinafter referred to as the alarm), which is a household photoelectric smoke fire alarm that can detect smoke generated during a fire and send out an alarm signal in a timely manner. The alarm uses photoelectric smoke sensing devices and excellent production technology, with stable operation and beautiful appearance. The smoke sensing part uses the principle of infrared light refracted by particles in the smoke to detect fire. When the alarm detects smoke and reaches the alarm concentration, the alarm red light flashes and an alarm sounds. The alarm has a self-test function and a low battery prompt function, which meets the technical requirements of the national standard "Independent Smoke Fire Detection Alarm" and has stable and reliable performance. It is suitable for various places such as homes, schools, nursing homes, guesthouses, hotels, factories, etc., and is used to detect fire smoke generated by wood, cotton fabrics, plastics and hydrocarbons.

This cable when extended can reach up to 2.0 meters long, it is highly durable with its triple-braided woven-nylon design, able to withstand more than 20,000 times bending. DESCRIPTION_KR: The ElectroJet Marine 29-250 is a pure Electric drive leisure yacht designed by a team of enthusiastic like-minded professionals to achieve a credible all electric alternative to motor yachting. Boasting 4 berths, a well-equipped galley, and spacious full height head the 29-250 can easily accommodate a family for a weekend getaway.

Fascia (myo-fascia): Adding high amplitude and high frequency vibration to a static tool releases the myo-fascia much faster and more thoroughly than a static tool. This unlocks and un-knots the fascia and opens up space and pathways for the fluid to move.; 2. Fluid: Vibration + Pressure creates tissue compression and tissue friction. Muscles: The high amplitude and frequency vibration combined with pressure relaxes the muscle. Like putting cookie dough in the microwave before you roll it out- it becomes more pliable.; 4. DESCRIPTION_KR: The TDSB630755C050ON is a digital temperature probe with Maxim Integrated DS18B20 sensor.  It is a popular and widely used digital temperature sensor with 1-Wire communication with the host device. The DS18B20 is known for its simplicity, accuracy, and ease of use, making it suitable for various applications.; The DS18B20 temperature probe utilizes a digital temperature sensor based on a silicon integrated circuit. It is designed to provide accurate temperature measurements with a resolution of up to 12 bits, allowing for temperature readings with precision down to 0.0625 degrees Celsius.; One of the key features of the DS18B20 is its unique 1-Wire interface. This interface enables multiple DS18B20 sensors to be connected to a single data line, simplifying the wiring and reducing the number of pins required for communication. This method results in minimal rebound voltage difference and delivers superior performance.
